title: Tier 0 material feedback wired
summary: Wire the Tier 0 feedback matrix: material-keyed footstep, landing, grab, and slide audio, particles, haptics, and camera shake, scaled by the environment scale multiplier.

acceptance_tests.test: Contacts produce the Bible §9 sound/particle/haptic/camera response keyed to the surface material; feedback scales with the scale multiplier.
Camera shake fires only on hard/recover landings and the flag plant; haptics follow the Bible §9 weights.
No frame-time regression beyond the SPEC §6 targets with feedback on.
